description: Local MedShield Obsidian checkpoints. Captures identifiers and lifecycle only; the agent supplies sanitized summaries. Review and trust through /hooks before activation.

hooks.command: python3 -X utf8 -c "import json,pathlib,runpy,subprocess; r=subprocess.run(['git','rev-parse','--show-toplevel'],capture_output=True,text=True); p=pathlib.Path(r.stdout.strip())/'.agents/scripts/project_memory_hook.py'; runpy.run_path(str(p),run_name='__main__') if r.returncode==0 and p.is_file() else print(json.dumps({'systemMessage':'MedShield memory capture unavailable: repository helper was not found.'}))"
